name: agentcall
description: Phone numbers, SMS, voice calls, and inbound + outbound AI voice for AI agents. Provision real numbers, send/receive texts, extract OTP codes, configure phone numbers to be answered by an OpenAI Realtime voice agent, or place autonomous AI-powered outbound calls.
author: agentcall

AGENTCALL_API_KEY.description: AgentCall API key (starts with ac_live_). Get one free at https://agentcall.co

billing.notice: Free tier: 1 phone number, 10 SMS/mo, 5 call min/mo — never charged. Pro ($19.99/mo): unlimited numbers + usage-based pricing (SMS $0.015, voice $0.035/min, AI voice $0.40/min outbound or inbound). See https://agentcall.co/#pricing

webhooks.notice: This skill can register webhook endpoints to receive real-time events (inbound SMS, OTP codes, call status, recordings, AI call transcripts). Webhooks require an HTTPS URL you control.

changelog: v2.1.2 (2026-04-29): Replace internal carrier names with user-friendly geographic phrasing in copy. v2.1.0 (2026-04-29): Added inbound AI voice — configure any supported number (US and Canada) to be answered autonomously by an OpenAI Realtime voice agent. Added GET /v1/calls/voices (8-voice catalog with sample MP3s) and GET /v1/calls/prompt-templates (5 ready-made templates: receptionist, lead qualifier, appointment booker, customer support, call screener). Default voice changed from alloy to shimmer (warmer, more welcoming). Updated tollfree pricing to $2.50/mo and mobile to $2/mo (correcting stale rates).
